points.notes:
"Even as revenue has picked up—reaching an annual pace of hundreds of millions of dollars just weeks after OpenAI launched a paid version of the chatbot in February"

Estimating "weeks" to mean ~4 weeks (ChatGPT Plus was launched on Feb 1, 2023), and "hundreds of millions" as >200M.

Note that while the in the exact revenue as of this report is uncertain, the 200M mark was likely crossed shortly after launch, so the timing of the 200M threshold is not very uncertain (+/- one month or so). · "hundreds of millions" in annual revenue · Reportedly "hundreds of millions"

"OpenAI is currently on pace to generate more than $1 billion in revenue over the next 12 months from the sale of artificial intelligence software and the computing capacity that powers it. That’s far ahead of revenue projections the company previously shared with its shareholders, according to a person with direct knowledge of the situation."

"Anthropic has told some investors it has been generating revenue at a $100 million annualized rate."

Also projected 200M by 2023-end: "By the end of this year, Anthropic projected it would generate revenue at a $200 million annualized pace, implying nearly $17 million in monthly revenue, one of the people said"

"ChatGPT maker OpenAI is generating revenue at a pace of $1.3 billion a year, CEO Sam Altman told staff this week, according to several people with knowledge of the matter."

Also refers to Anthropic's contemporaneous $100M in ARR
"OpenAI recently topped $1.6 billion in annualized revenue on strong growth from its ChatGPT product, up from $1.3 billion as of mid-October, according to two people with knowledge of the figure."

"OpenAI’s revenues have surpassed $2bn on an annualised basis, as the runaway success of its flagship artificial intelligence product ChatGPT puts it among the fastest-growing technology companies in history. The San Francisco-based start-up’s yearly run rate — a measure of the previous month’s revenue multiplied by 12 — hit the $2bn milestone in December 2023, according to two people with knowledge of its finances."
"our run-rate revenue has grown from $87 million at the start of 2024 to over $5 billion in August 2025"

"OpenAI has more than doubled its annualized revenue to $3.4 billion in the past six months or so, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has told staff, a sign that growth in the ChatGPT developer’s business is accelerating despite intensifying competition."

Possibly disputed by OpenAI, but OpenAI didn't provide any more details, so it's likely roughly accurate.

"An OpenAI spokeswoman said the financial details were “inaccurate,” without elaborating."

"OpenAI’s monthly revenue hit $300 million in August, up 1,700 percent since the beginning of 2023, and the company expects about $3.7 billion in annual sales this year, according to financial documents reviewed by The New York Times."
"Altman has told investors that the startup’s annualized recurring revenues—a projection of annual revenue based on recent receipts—recently hit about $4 billion."
"In December, Anthropic’s revenue hit an annualized $1 billion, which was an increase of roughly 10x year over year, the source said. The company’s revenue comes primarily from enterprise sales."

"For all of last year, OpenAI had around $5.5 billion in [annual recurring revenue]." This quote doesn't quite make sense—OpenAI definitely did not have flat ARR across 2024. The most likely interpretation is that OpenAI reached 5.5B at the end of last year.

"Its annualized revenue—a measure of the past month's revenue multiplied by 12—has grown from $1 billion at the end of last year to $1.4 billion as of earlier this month, according to a person who has seen the numbers."

"Annualized revenue reached $2 billion in the first quarter, the company confirmed, more than doubling from a $1 billion rate in the prior period."

Additionally, a second source corroborates $2B annualized revenue by end of March:

"The figure crossed $2 billion around the end of March"
https://www.cnbc.com/2025/05/30/anthropic-hits-3-billion-in-annualized-revenue-on-business-demand-for-ai.html

"Artificial intelligence developer Anthropic is making about $3 billion in annualized revenue, according to two sources familiar with the matter, in an early validation of generative AI use in the business world.
The milestone, which projects the company’s current sales over the course of a year, is a significant jump from December 2024 when the metric was nearly $1 billion, the sources said. The figure crossed $2 billion around the end of March, and at May’s end it hit $3 billion, one of the sources said."

"OpenAI has hit $10 billion in annual recurring revenue, or ARR, less than three years after launching its popular ChatGPT chatbot. The figure includes sales from the company’s consumer products; ChatGPT business products; and its application programming interface, or API. It excludes licensing revenue from Microsoft and large one-time deals, according to an OpenAI spokesperson. For all of last year, OpenAI had around $5.5 billion in ARR. Reaching its meteoric growth rates requires a substantial amount of cash. The San Francisco-based startup lost about $5 billion last year."

the line about "For all of last year, OpenAI had around $5.5 billion in ARR." probably means $5.5B as of end of 2024, but unclear. check article for clarification?

Also could be higher under different accounting, due to the Microsoft license exclusion. This may be a different standard from other OpenAI revenue reports.

"Anthropic Revenue Hits $4 Billion Annual Pace as Competition With Cursor Intensifies"

"The hiring underscores the frenetic nature of talent moves in the AI field this year. It also comes as Anthropic’s revenue is accelerating as businesses pay to access its Claude AI models. It reached a pace of $4 billion annually, or $333 million per month, up almost four times from the start of the year, according to people familiar with the finances."

"As the most recent funding talks came together, Anthropic’s sales have surged. The company was generating about $4 billion in annual recurring revenue earlier this month, Bloomberg previously reported. By the end of July, that number had climbed to about $5 billion, according to one of the people. The company expects its recurring revenue could hit $9 billion by the end of this year."

This was also corroborated by Anthropic in its Series F announcement, citing annualized run-rate

"At the beginning of 2025, less than two years after launch, Anthropic’s run-rate revenue had grown to approximately $1 billion. By August 2025, just eight months later, our run-rate revenue reached over $5 billion—making Anthropic one of the fastest-growing technology companies in history."

CFO Sarah Friar said on CNBC that July was the first month that OpenAI achieved 1B in revenue.

Corroborated by a report from The Information:

"OpenAI roughly doubled its revenue in the first seven months of the year, reaching $12 billion in annualized revenue, according to a person who spoke to OpenAI executives."
